snippet.title: Zero-G Alpha 5.3 — Asteroid Mining Complete Guide | Browser Space MMO
snippet.description:
🚀 Zero-G Alpha 5.3 is live — and asteroid mining is here!

In this tutorial I'll show you everything you need to know to start mining asteroids in the Belt: from choosing the right ship and buying the right equipment, to launching probes, entering a mining instance, scanning asteroids, and extracting rare compounds.
Asteroid mining in Zero-G is a fully multiplayer experience — bring friends for the best results!
⏱️ Follow the chapters below to jump to any step.
🎮 Play Zero-G free in your browser — no download, no install:
🔗 LINKS
▶ Play free (no download): https://space.zerog.live
▶ Massivelyop: https://massivelyop.com/2026/01/23/project-zero-g-is-a-sci-fi-browser-mmo-that-uses-real-world-nasa-data-to-build-its-space-sim-world/
▶ Discord: https://discord.gg/C9dWFP2jJt
▶ IGDB: https://www.igdb.com/games/zero-g-mmo
▶ IndieDB: https://www.indiedb.com/games/project-zero-g


0:00 — Zero-G Alpha 5.3 — What's new
0:19 — Step 1: Choose the right combat ship
0:35 — Step 2: Buy Asteroid Mining Probes at the General Store
1:05 — Step 3: Buy Mining Laser Crystals
1:30 — Step 4: Buy Scanning Dust or Graphene
1:55 — Step 5: Fly your ships to the Asteroid Belt or Ceres
2:40 — Step 6a: Move from orbit into open space in the Belt
3:05 — Step 6b: Open your Cargo Panel and launch probes
3:40 — Step 7a: Stay close to your probes while they scan
4:10 — Step 7b: Be ready to intercept detected instances fast!
5:08 — Step 8: Fly through the instance and identify asteroid types
5:50 — Step 9: Select the best asteroids and scan them
6:09 — Step 10: Equip your Mining Crystal and start mining!
